_comment: The emtk form of the anisotropy wizard: one panel per step, drawn by emtk.view_form.draw_form over NativeAnisotropyModel. The Qt wizard keeps ../anisotropy.view.json.

sections.title: Reader settings
sections.description: How the text decays are read: the Qt wizard used whatever reader the active setup had; here the settings are visible.

sections.label: Two stacked VV/VH files
sections.description: Each IRF/data file holds both polarization channels (one IRF file, one data file); otherwise choose four separate files.

sections.label: First column is time (ns)
sections.description: Keep a measured time axis unchanged; otherwise the first column is treated as channel indices. Not used with stacked files.

sections.label: Use file header
sections.description: Read available channel/calibration information from the file header.

sections.label: Bin width (ns)
sections.description: Time per histogram channel for channel-index or stacked files; a time-axis column is preserved.

sections.label: Repetition rate (MHz)
sections.description: Excitation repetition rate used to initialize the lifetime fits.

sections.label: Header rows
sections.description: Number of header rows to skip while reading text decays.

sections.title: Background region
sections.description: The signal-free channels whose mean is subtracted from both IRFs; drag the green box in the plot or type the channel numbers.

sections.label: Background from
sections.description: First background channel, inclusive; choose a signal-free region.

sections.label: Background to
sections.description: Last background channel boundary, exclusive.

sections.title: Instrument corrections
sections.description: Detection-efficiency and channel-mixing corrections applied to the VV/VH fits.

sections.label: g-factor
sections.description: Detection-efficiency ratio between the VV and VH channels; it scales the anisotropy as a whole.

sections.label: l1
sections.description: Channel-mixing correction l1 of the parallel channel (high-aperture objectives).

sections.label: l2
sections.description: Channel-mixing correction l2 of the perpendicular channel.

sections.title: Lifetime spectrum
sections.description: The fluorescence lifetime components shared by the VV and VH fits.

columns.title: Amplitude
columns.tooltip: Relative amplitude of the lifetime component; double-click to edit.

columns.title: Lifetime (ns)
columns.tooltip: Fluorescence lifetime of the component in nanoseconds; double-click to edit.

sections.label: Amplitude
sections.description: Amplitude of the component to add.

sections.label: Lifetime (ns)
sections.description: Lifetime of the component to add, in nanoseconds.

buttons.label: Add component
buttons.description: Append the entered amplitude and lifetime.

buttons.label: Remove selected
buttons.description: Remove the selected row (the last one when none is selected).

sections.title: Rotation spectrum
sections.description: The rotational correlation components shared by the VV and VH fits.

columns.title: Amplitude
columns.tooltip: Absolute anisotropy contribution of the component; double-click to edit.

columns.title: Correlation time (ns)
columns.tooltip: Rotational correlation time of the component in nanoseconds; double-click to edit.

sections.label: Amplitude
sections.description: Amplitude of the component to add.

sections.label: Correlation time (ns)
sections.description: Rotational correlation time of the component to add, in nanoseconds.

buttons.label: Add component
buttons.description: Append the entered amplitude and correlation time.

buttons.label: Remove selected
buttons.description: Remove the selected row (the last one when none is selected).
